title: dichanthelium lanuginosum var. spretum
intro: Dichanthelium lanuginosum var. spretum, commonly known as hairy panic grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine, particularly in North America, and is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of hairy panic grass include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.
